page.overview:
What is gigantamax?

It is a variant of Dynamax; while any Pokémon can Dynamax, only certain Pokémon can Gigantamax. In addition to changing the Pokémon's size, it changes its appearance as well. It works similarly to Mega Evolution, but unlike Mega Evolution, it doesn't have any Pokémon to change or gain a new type upon changing its size and appearance.

Pokémon capable of Gigantamaxing can typically be caught in Max Raid Battles, however, these encounters are usually low. Only a few dens in the Wild Area and the Isle of Armor feature battles with Gigantamax Pokémon, while most dens in the Crown Tundra can have Gigantamax Pokémon Max Raid Battles.

After completing the Champions' Cup for the first time, Leon will leave behind a Poké Ball in his house at Postwick containing a Charmander capable of Gigantamaxing.

Others, such as Meowth, are set to be distributed via events. Notably, Pikachu and Eevee capable of Gigantamax can be received if the player has save data of Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee!, respectively. Pikachu, Meowth, and Eevee capable of Gigantamax cannot evolve.
